brief:
Jerusalem District Electricity Company announced planned power outages affecting multiple areas of Ramallah and Al-Bireh governorate, the Maan Wire reported. The cuts will run from 8:30 a.m. to 3:30 p.m. on specified dates, with different neighborhoods subject to disruptions on different days.

The company expressed regret over the necessity of the outages but provided no explanation for the scheduled disruptions. Residents were advised to prepare for the extended midday blackouts across the affected zones in the district.
